source_title: Roll a coin across your knuckles
source_description: Roll a coin across the knuckles of one hand so a watcher can see it travel.

source_title: Catch a coin from the elbow
source_description: Place a coin on your elbow and catch it in the same hand.

source_title: Spin a pen and stop it
source_description: Spin a pen around your thumb and stop it in a writing grip.

source_title: Send a yo-yo down and back
source_description: Send a yo-yo down and bring it back to your hand.

source_title: Land a ball in a cup
source_description: Swing a tethered ball into a cup and leave it there.

source_title: Spin a top and catch it
source_description: Spin a top and catch it while it is still turning, or let it spin out and say so.

source_title: Balance a stick on a finger
source_description: Balance a light stick upright on one finger for a moment you can show.

source_title: Pass a ball around your waist
source_description: Pass a ball around your waist and back to the start without a drop.

source_title: Juggle two balls in one hand
source_description: Keep two balls moving in one hand, separate from a three-ball pattern.

source_title: Spring a deck between your hands
source_description: Spring a small deck from one hand to the other so the cards arrive in a stack.

source_title: Palm a coin and show the hand
source_description: Hide a coin in the palm, show the hand as empty to a person you told, then produce the coin.

source_title: Hop a band between fingers
source_description: Move a rubber band from one pair of fingers to another with a hop the watcher can see.

source_title: Link two clips with a fold
source_description: Fold a strip so two paperclips link when you pull the ends, then show the fold.

source_title: Snap on both hands
source_description: Snap the fingers of each hand so another person can hear both snaps.

source_title: Spin a plate on a stick
source_description: Spin a plate or a lightweight disc on a stick and keep it up for a moment.

source_title: Toss and catch a diabolo
source_description: Toss a diabolo up from the string and catch it on the string again.

source_title: Swing soft poi in one plane
source_description: Swing one soft poi in a flat circle beside your body.

source_title: Stack cups and unstack them
source_description: Stack three cups into a pyramid and take them down into a nested stack.

source_title: Build a house of cards
source_description: Build a house of cards with a base and one story above it.

source_title: Run a short domino line
source_description: Stand a short line of dominoes so tipping the first tips the last.

source_title: Skip a stone once
source_description: Throw a stone so it touches the water more than once, or say the water was wrong for it.

source_title: Walk heel to toe on a line
source_description: Walk a straight line with the heel touching the toe of the other foot.

source_title: Write with the other hand
source_description: Write your name with the hand you do not usually write with, so it can be read.

source_title: Read a line upside down
source_description: Read a printed line that is upside down to you, without turning the page.

source_title: Mirror-write your name
source_description: Write your name so it reads correctly in a mirror.

source_title: Say a tongue twister cleanly
source_description: Say a short tongue twister through once without a stumble you ignore.

source_title: Beatbox a kick and a snare
source_description: Make two different mouth sounds, one for a kick and one for a snare, and alternate them.

source_title: Whistle a two-note signal
source_description: Whistle two different notes as a signal and have someone copy the order.

source_title: Play a note on a blade of grass
source_description: Make one tone with a blade of grass or a leaf held to the lips.

source_title: Blow across a bottle
source_description: Blow across a bottle mouth and change the note by changing the water.

source_title: Make a hand shadow someone can name
source_description: Make a hand shadow and ask someone to name the animal or object before you tell them.

source_title: Clap a round with a partner
source_description: Clap a short pattern, then have a partner start it while you continue.

source_title: Drum a pattern on your chest
source_description: Tap a three-hit pattern on your chest and repeat it once the same way.

source_title: Fold a paper hat that stays
source_description: Fold a paper hat and wear it long enough to turn your head.

source_title: Fold a boat and float it
source_description: Fold a paper boat and show whether it floats for a moment.

source_title: Fold a fortune teller and use it
source_description: Fold a paper fortune teller, write four outcomes, and use it once as a game.

source_title: Fold a letter into itself
source_description: Fold a written sheet so the writing is inside and the sheet stays closed.

source_title: Fold a map to one panel
source_description: Fold a paper map so the part you need stays visible and the rest stays folded.

source_title: Cut a symmetric snowflake
source_description: Fold and cut a paper snowflake that opens into a matching pattern.

source_title: Make a pinwheel that spins
source_description: Make a paper pinwheel and show it spinning when you blow or walk.

source_title: Stand a card triangle
source_description: Slot or lean cards into a triangle that stands, then set a light object on it or say it will not hold one.

source_title: Fold a fan that opens
source_description: Fold a paper fan and open it with one hand.

source_title: Make a paper spring
source_description: Fold or cut a paper spring that stretches and returns.

source_title: Make a pop-up fold
source_description: Make one pop-up fold inside a card so a tab stands when the card opens.

source_title: Cut a paper loop and say what you get
source_description: Make a paper loop with a half twist, cut along it, and say what happened.

source_title: Flex a hexaflexagon
source_description: Fold a simple flexagon and flex it so a new face shows.

source_title: Read a Roman numeral date
source_description: Read a year written in Roman numerals and write it in ordinary digits.

source_title: Count on one hand in binary
source_description: Show the numbers from zero to five with finger positions you can explain.

source_title: Tap a word in Morse
source_description: Tap a short word in Morse from a chart you can see, then check it against the chart.

source_title: Finger-spell your name
source_description: Finger-spell your name from a chart, slowly enough to be followed.

source_title: Read one braille cell
source_description: Learn one braille cell from a reference and find it again by touch or by sight.

source_title: Add two numbers on an abacus
source_description: Add two small numbers on an abacus and check the sum in writing.

source_title: Link items in a story
source_description: Remember eight ordinary items by linking them in one story, then recall them without the list.

source_title: Redraw a pattern from memory
source_description: Look at a short pattern, cover it, and redraw it.

source_title: Peg three items to three pictures
source_description: Attach three items to three fixed pictures and recall the items from the pictures.

source_title: Tie a bow that survives a tug
source_description: Tie a gift bow and tug the loops without it coming undone.

source_title: Fold a napkin so it stands
source_description: Fold a napkin into a shape that stands on a table.

source_title: Move a bean with chopsticks
source_description: Move one bean from one dish to another with chopsticks.

source_title: Make a pom-pom that holds
source_description: Make a yarn pom-pom and show it holds together when you shake it.

source_title: Finger-knit a cord
source_description: Finger-knit a short cord and pull it so the stitches stay.

source_title: Stitch a cross-stitch row
source_description: Sew a short row of cross-stitches that all cross the same way.

source_title: Bead a repeating pattern
source_description: String a bead pattern of three colors that repeats, and read the pattern back.

source_title: Braid a short lanyard
source_description: Braid a short lanyard from three strands and tug the end.

source_title: Wrap a yarn diamond
source_description: Wrap yarn around two sticks so a diamond pattern shows.

source_title: Sew a blanket stitch
source_description: Sew a short blanket stitch along the edge of scrap cloth.

source_title: Make a tassel
source_description: Make a tassel, bind the head, and show the skirt hanging.

source_title: Spool-knit a few rounds
source_description: Knit a few rounds on a spool or a fork and pull the cord through.

source_title: Make a corner bookmark
source_description: Make a corner bookmark and fit it on a page.

source_title: Erase a pencil line without a tear
source_description: Erase a pencil line and show the paper still whole.

source_title: Sharpen a pencil to a point
source_description: Sharpen a pencil until it writes a fine line.

source_title: Draw parallel lines with a guide
source_description: Draw two lines that stay the same distance apart.

source_title: Draw a circle with string
source_description: Draw a circle with a pin or a held center and a string, and mark the center.

source_title: Fold a right angle
source_description: Fold a paper right angle and test it against a corner you trust.

source_title: Check a square with a 3-4-5 string
source_description: Lay a 3-4-5 string triangle and say whether a drawn corner matches the right angle.

source_title: Center a frame on a page
source_description: Place a rectangle so the margins on the left and right match.

source_title: Cut a window in card
source_description: Cut a window in card so a picture shows through and the border stays in one piece.

source_title: Hinge a photo on a page
source_description: Attach a photo or a scrap print with a hinge so you can lift it.

source_title: Label the back of a print
source_description: Write a date and a short title on the back of a print with a pencil.

source_title: Deal a fan of cards
source_description: Spread a small fan of cards so each corner shows.

source_title: Shuffle a small deck overhand
source_description: Shuffle a small deck with an overhand shuffle and square it.

source_title: Deal into two even piles
source_description: Deal a small even deck into two piles with the same count.

source_title: Float a paperclip
source_description: Float a dry paperclip on water and say what happens when you touch the surface.

source_title: Separate ink on paper
source_description: Put a water-based dot on paper, let water creep through it, and say what colors you see.

source_title: Pick up a clip with a nail coil
source_description: Wrap wire around a nail, connect a battery briefly, and see whether the nail picks up a clip.

source_title: Reveal a lemon line with a lamp
source_description: Write with lemon juice, let it dry, and warm it with a lamp until the line shows or you stop.

source_title: See an upside-down view through a pinhole
source_description: Make a pinhole in a card and describe the upside-down view of a lamp or a window.

source_title: Align two mirrors to see behind you
source_description: Hold two mirrors so you can see something behind you.

source_title: Make a rainbow with a glass and a lamp
source_description: Use a glass of water and a lamp to cast a colored patch, and point to the colors you see.

source_title: Tune three bottles
source_description: Tune three bottles to three notes you can tell apart and play them in an order.

source_title: Strum a rubber-band box
source_description: Stretch bands over a box and play two different notes.

source_title: Find the full glass by sound
source_description: Tap glasses with different amounts of water and say which sounds lower.

source_title: Finish a tangram outline
source_description: Fill a tangram outline with the pieces, without looking at a solution picture.

source_title: Solve a rebus
source_description: Solve a rebus from the pictures and say the phrase.

source_title: Move one match in a figure
source_description: Move one match in a drawn or stick figure so the figure matches the goal you stated.

source_title: Fill a small nonogram
source_description: Fill a small picture grid from the numbers, and check the row clues.

source_title: Draw a maze and time a friend
source_description: Draw a maze with one path and time someone from the start to the end.

source_title: Write a palindrome
source_description: Write a short palindrome and show it reads the same backward.

source_title: Solve a two-move slider
source_description: Solve a tiny sliding puzzle that needs only a few moves, and count the moves you used.

source_title: Find a heavier ball
source_description: Use a balance twice at most to find which of three balls is heavier, if you know one is.

source_title: Read a measuring cup at eye level
source_description: Read a line on a measuring cup with your eye level with the line.

source_title: Tare a scale
source_description: Put a container on a scale, tare it, and weigh one thing inside it.

source_title: Check a scale with a known weight
source_description: Weigh an object whose weight is printed and say whether the scale agrees.

source_title: Carry a tray on one hand
source_description: Carry a light tray on one flat hand across a short distance.

source_title: Peel in one strip
source_description: Peel an orange or a similar fruit in one strip if the peel allows, or say where it broke.

source_title: Open a jar with a better grip
source_description: Open a jar you are allowed to open, using a cloth or a grip, and say what worked.

source_title: Sort buttons by holes
source_description: Sort a handful of buttons by the number of holes.

source_title: Sort coins by the year you can read
source_description: Sort coins into decades or years you can actually read, and set aside worn ones.

source_title: Sort stones by one feature
source_description: Sort a few stones by one feature you name before you start.

source_title: Match a key to an outline
source_description: Draw the outline of a key and match the key back to that drawing among two outlines.

source_title: Tell two screws apart by the thread
source_description: Tell two screws apart by the thread you can see, not only by the head.

source_title: Tell a knit from a woven cloth
source_description: Tell a knit cloth from a woven cloth by the structure you can see or stretch.

source_title: Read a boarding pass
source_description: Find the gate, the seat, and the boarding time on a pass or a sample.

source_title: Find a seat from a row number
source_description: Find a seat from a row and a letter in a room, a vehicle, or a drawing.

source_title: Set a lock to a code you wrote
source_description: Set a combination lock to a code you wrote down, then open it from the note.

source_title: Read a queue ticket
source_description: Read a queue number and say how you will know when it is your turn.

source_title: Read a locker label
source_description: Match a locker number to a key or a ticket.

source_title: Note the car you boarded
source_description: Note the car or carriage you entered so you can find an exit or a companion.

source_title: Explain a trick after you show it
source_description: Show one small trick you can do, then explain the method to the person who watched.

source_title: Film your hands so the move shows
source_description: Film your hands doing one move so a viewer can see the move.

source_title: Bow and stop
source_description: End a short trick with a bow or a nod and do not add another trick.

source_title: Teach a one-minute trick
source_description: Teach a trick that takes about a minute, and watch the learner do it.

source_title: Roll a hoop and catch it
source_description: Roll a hoop in a straight line and catch it before it falls.

source_title: Turn a hoop at your waist
source_description: Keep a hoop turning around your waist for several turns.

source_title: Spin a ball on a finger
source_description: Spin a ball on one finger and catch it.

source_title: Cross a jump rope once
source_description: Jump a rope with one jump, then cross the arms for one jump and uncross.

source_title: Flip a card cleanly
source_description: Flip one card from face down to face up without sending it off the table.

source_title: Separate two paper rings
source_description: Make two paper rings that look linked and show whether they are, by the cut you planned.

source_title: Build a card bridge
source_description: Bridge a small gap with cards so a coin can sit on it, or say the gap is too wide.

source_title: Balance a fork and explain it
source_description: Balance a fork and spoon or a fork on a glass using a match or a toothpick setup you can explain.

source_title: Referee a coin flip
source_description: Flip a coin where both people can see it, and call the result only after it lands.

source_title: Read opposite faces on a die
source_description: Say which faces are opposite on a standard die you can check.

source_title: Pour to a marked line
source_description: Pour water to a marked line and stop at the line.

source_title: Make a compass rose you can turn
source_description: Draw a compass rose, label the four directions, and turn it to match a known north.

source_title: Copy a rhythm you just heard
source_description: Hear a short clapped rhythm and clap it back.

source_title: Make a note on a straw
source_description: Cut a straw end, blow one note, and shorten it to change the note.

source_title: Roll a cloth strip
source_description: Roll a cloth strip into a tight roll that stays when you set it down.

source_title: Fold a cloth into a triangle
source_description: Fold a square cloth into a triangle that stays folded.

source_title: Thread a belt
source_description: Thread a belt through the loops so it sits flat and the end goes through the buckle.

source_title: Tie a bow on a package
source_description: Tie a bow on a wrapped package so the knot sits in the middle of one face.

source_title: Stack dice to a sum you named
source_description: Stack dice so the top faces add to a sum you wrote before you started.

source_title: Invent a harmless code
source_description: Invent a code for five letters, write the key, and decode a word with it.

source_title: Read the digits under a barcode
source_description: Read the digits printed under a barcode and find them again on a second look.

source_title: Spot a repeated bead in a string
source_description: Find a color that repeats too soon in a bead string you made or were given.

source_title: Make a paper pocket
source_description: Fold a paper pocket that holds a card.

source_title: Trace a coin and fit it
source_description: Trace a coin and fit the same coin back into the circle.

source_title: Clap the syllables and stop
source_description: Clap the syllables of a word and stop when the word ends.

source_title: Hum a note and stop on a sign
source_description: Hum one note and stop when a partner raises a hand.

source_title: Pass a cup behind your back
source_description: Pass a plastic cup from one hand to the other behind your back without a drop.

source_title: Balance a spoon on your nose
source_description: Balance a light spoon on your nose for a moment, or say it slid.

source_title: Name the fold that changed a dart
source_description: Fold a paper dart, change one named fold, and say what the flight did.

source_title: Tie a knot you can release
source_description: Tie a slipped knot around a rail or a bag handle and release it by pulling the free end.

source_title: Spot a knot that will slip
source_description: Compare two tied cords and say which knot slips when you pull the free end.

source_title: Put a key on a ring
source_description: Open a split ring and put one key on it, then show the key stays.

source_title: Untangle a chain
source_description: Untangle a light chain and lay it in one line.

source_title: Gather a cloth edge
source_description: Sew a running stitch on scrap and pull it so the edge gathers.

source_title: Run a cord through a casing
source_description: Run a cord through a fabric or paper channel and show both ends.

source_title: Pin a temporary hem
source_description: Pin a hem so it holds for a try-on and can be removed without a tear.

source_title: Roll a tie for a bag
source_description: Roll a necktie so it does not crease into a hard fold, and unroll it.

source_title: Tie a scarf so it stays
source_description: Tie a scarf with one knot and turn your head without it falling.

source_title: Button a cuff
source_description: Button a cuff, or a spare cuff, with the hand that has to reach it.

source_title: Fold a towel that stacks
source_description: Fold a towel into a rectangle and stack a second fold on it so the edges match.

source_title: Hang trousers so the creases match
source_description: Hang trousers so the legs lie together and the waist is supported.

source_title: Fold a cube from a net
source_description: Cut or use a cube net, fold it, and show a closed cube.

source_title: Reject a net that will not fold
source_description: Look at two cube nets and say which one will not fold into a closed cube, then test with paper.

source_title: Find the center with diagonals
source_description: Draw both diagonals of a rectangle and mark where they cross.

source_title: Mark a vertical with string
source_description: Hang a string with a small weight and mark a vertical line beside it.

source_title: Draw a viewfinder
source_description: Cut a small rectangle and use it to choose a view before you draw or photograph.

source_title: Fill the frame with a texture
source_description: Take a photo where a texture fills the frame, with no horizon.

source_title: Make a silhouette
source_description: Place a lamp so a profile becomes a dark shape on a wall, and trace it if you may.

source_title: Trace a profile
source_description: Trace a consenting person's profile or your own shadow, and show the line.

source_title: Mime a heavy box
source_description: Pick up an imaginary box so a watcher can tell it is heavy.

source_title: Pass an imaginary object
source_description: Pass an imaginary object to a partner so they receive its size.

source_title: Hold a still pose
source_description: Hold a pose while someone walks around you, and say what moved.

source_title: Hit a mark and turn
source_description: Walk to a mark on the floor, stop, and turn to a named direction.

source_title: Match steps with a partner
source_description: Walk beside a partner and match their step length for a short distance.

source_title: Clap off the beat
source_description: Tap a steady beat with a foot and clap between the taps.

source_title: Write a postcard that fits
source_description: Write a message that fits in the message area of a postcard and leave the address side clear.

source_title: See if a letter is under a limit
source_description: Weigh a letter and say whether it is under a limit you wrote down first.

source_title: Roll a towel for a bag
source_description: Roll a towel tightly enough that it stays rolled in a bag.

source_title: Make a box divider
source_description: Fold a divider that splits a box into two spaces a small object cannot cross.

source_title: Label a jar so the tape peels
source_description: Label a jar with tape you can peel off without leaving the jar for someone else to scrape.

source_title: Twist hair and pin it
source_description: Twist a section of hair, or a yarn stand-in, and pin it so it stays.

source_title: Tie a hair ribbon that stays
source_description: Tie a ribbon around a handle or a consenting ponytail so the bow survives a tug.

source_title: Tape a costume hem
source_description: Tape a temporary hem that holds for a bow and peels off.

source_title: Pin a cape so it releases
source_description: Pin a cloth at the shoulder with a safety pin you can undo quickly.

source_title: Mark stage left from the stage
source_description: Stand on a practice stage and mark the side that is your left as you face the audience.

source_title: Mime a wall
source_description: Show an imaginary wall by touching it in three places a watcher can follow.

source_title: Follow a partner's palm
source_description: Keep your palm a short distance from a partner's palm as they move.

source_title: Count a tempo aloud
source_description: Count a steady tempo aloud and stop on a number you chose.

source_title: Make a paper beard
source_description: Cut a paper beard, try it on, and take it off.

source_title: Release a gather
source_description: Gather scrap cloth and then let the thread go so the cloth lies flatter.

source_title: Read a postage mark
source_description: Read a stamp or a printed postage mark and say what it does not tell you.

source_title: Pack a cylinder so it does not roll
source_description: Pack a cylinder in a box so it does not roll when you tip the box a little.

source_title: Make a neck rest from a scarf
source_description: Roll a scarf into a rest you can put behind your neck and then unroll.

source_title: Draw a hand as a simple shape
source_description: Draw a hand as a palm shape plus a thumb, and ask someone to point to the thumb.

source_title: Shade a circle so it looks round
source_description: Shade a circle with one side darker and say where the light is.

source_title: Compare two prints you made
source_description: Make two prints of your own finger and say one way they match.

source_title: Fold a fitted sheet
source_description: Fold a fitted sheet into a rectangle you can stack, and say where a corner is tucked.

source_title: Center a title on a card
source_description: Write a title so the space on the left and the right looks even.

source_title: Make a paper accordion book
source_description: Fold a strip into an accordion and stand it so two pages show.

source_title: Read a platform letter
source_description: Read the platform or track mark on a sign and say which train side it names.

source_title: Ask for a water refill
source_description: Ask for a refill of a bottle you already have, and stop if the answer is no.

source_title: Copy a short grid from memory
source_description: Look at a three-by-three grid of marks, cover it, and copy it.

source_title: Teach a clap and stop the group
source_description: Teach two people a clap and stop them with a sign you agreed.

source_title: Balance a card on a finger
source_description: Balance a card on one finger long enough to show, then catch it.

source_title: Spin a coin and trap it
source_description: Spin a coin on a table and trap it under a hand without sliding it off.

source_title: Make a paper whistle
source_description: Fold a paper whistle, blow one note, and stop.

source_title: Spin fire poi
source_description: Fire and burns. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_description: Severe injury. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_description: Fall risk. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Land a bottle upright
source_description: Flip a partly filled plastic bottle so it lands upright and stays.

source_title: Roll a pencil and catch it
source_description: Roll a pencil down your forearm and catch it in that hand.

source_title: Spin a book on a finger
source_description: Spin a light book on one finger and catch it when it tips.

source_title: Flick a coin along a table
source_description: Flick a coin so it slides and stops inside a target you marked.

source_title: Catch a coin off the back of the hand
source_description: Rest a coin on the back of your hand, toss it, and catch it.

source_title: Bounce a ball under a leg
source_description: Bounce a ball under one raised leg and catch it.

source_title: Make a three-ring paper chain
source_description: Link three paper rings into one chain that holds when you lift an end.

source_title: Cut a row of paper people
source_description: Fold a strip and cut one figure so it opens into a row of figures holding hands.

source_title: Fold a paper cup that holds a bean
source_description: Fold a paper cup and put a dry bean in it without the bean falling through.

source_title: Spin a card top
source_description: Make a top from card and a short stick, spin it, and say when it falls.

source_title: Tie a lark's head on a ring
source_description: Tie a lark's head that holds a cord to a ring, then undo it.

source_title: Conduct four beats
source_description: Beat a four-pattern in the air and have a partner clap on the first beat.

source_title: Count a group in
source_description: Count a short preparation and have two people start together on the next beat.

source_title: Buzz a lip tone
source_description: Buzz the lips to make a tone, then stop the tone while the air continues for a moment.

source_title: Sound a comb and paper
source_description: Hum through paper folded on a comb and stop when you choose.

source_title: Fade a hummed note
source_description: Hum a note and make it quieter until it disappears.

source_title: Write a rhythm you clapped
source_description: Clap a four-beat pattern and write marks that a partner can clap back.

source_title: Name the strum direction
source_description: Strum once downward and once upward and say which was which.

source_title: Fret a note and name the fret
source_description: Press one fret, sound the string, and say the fret number.

source_title: Read one tab number
source_description: Point to one number on a tab staff and press that fret on the string it names.

source_title: Say what a capo changes
source_description: Put a capo on one fret and say which open strings moved, without claiming a new key by ear.

source_title: Play three keys in a named order
source_description: Name three piano keys, play them in that order, and stop.

source_title: Find a group of two black keys
source_description: Find a pair of black keys on a keyboard and name the white key between them.

source_title: Cut a five-point star
source_description: Fold paper and cut one star, then open it and count the points.

source_title: Drop a paper helicopter
source_description: Make a paper helicopter, drop it, and say whether it spun.

source_title: Hop a paper frog
source_description: Fold a paper frog, press the back, and show a hop.

source_title: Pop a folded paper popper
source_description: Fold a paper popper, swing it once, and say whether it popped.

source_title: Make a soap film on a loop
source_description: Dip a paper or wire loop in soapy water and show a film, then pop it on purpose.

source_title: Float and sink the same egg
source_description: Show one egg sinking in fresh water and floating in salty water.

source_title: Bend a thin stream
source_description: Charge a comb and bring it near a thin stream of water so the stream moves.

source_title: Move hanging foil
source_description: Hang two small foil pieces and show them move when a charged comb comes near.

source_title: Float a stroked needle
source_description: Stroke a needle with a magnet, float it on a cork, and see it settle on a north-south line you check with a compass or a map.

source_title: Read a clock with Roman numerals
source_description: Read the hour on a clock face that uses Roman numerals.

source_title: Stop when a sand timer ends
source_description: Turn a sand timer, start a small task, and stop when the sand finishes.

source_title: Complete a cut of the deck
source_description: Cut a small deck and complete the cut so the original top card is buried.

source_title: Bridge-shuffle a small deck
source_description: Split a small deck, riffle the corners, and bridge the cards back into one pack.

source_title: Spread cards in a row
source_description: Spread a small packet in an even row and square it again.

source_title: Name the missing card
source_description: Look at twelve cards of one suit, see one removed, and name it.

source_title: Show that touching dice sum to seven
source_description: Stack two dice and show that the two touching faces add to seven.

source_title: Cut four pieces that fit back
source_description: Cut a picture card into four pieces and fit those pieces back into the rectangle.

source_title: Draw a shape without lifting
source_description: Draw a simple house or envelope outline and say whether the pencil left the page.

source_title: Make a cat's cradle
source_description: Take a string loop from open hands to a cradle, then back to open hands.

source_title: Pass a cat's cradle
source_description: Hold a cradle so a partner can take it onto their hands.

source_title: Open an envelope without tearing the letter
source_description: Open an envelope and take out a paper without tearing that paper.

source_title: Link two rubber bands
source_description: Link two rubber bands into a chain that holds a light tug.

source_title: Hit a paper target with a band
source_description: Shoot a rubber band at a paper target and say whether you hit the mark you drew.

source_title: Make a paper claw that grabs
source_description: Fold a paper claw, open it, and pick up a light ball of paper.

source_title: Read a dreidel face
source_description: Spin a dreidel and read the letter that lands on top.

source_title: Throw on an agreed count
source_description: Throw rock, paper, or scissors on a count you agreed, and say who won.

source_title: Deal around a circle
source_description: Deal one card to each person in a small circle and stop when the turn returns to the start.

source_title: Put one suit in order
source_description: Lay one suit face up and put it in order from low to high.

source_title: Drop a paper loop glider
source_description: Make a glider with a paper loop, launch it, and say whether it flew or dove.

source_title: See if a paper boomerang returns
source_description: Fold a paper boomerang, throw it once, and say honestly whether it came back.

source_title: Blow one bubble and pop it
source_description: Dip a loop, blow one bubble, and pop that bubble on purpose.

source_title: Stick a balloon to a wall
source_description: Charge a balloon and stick it to a wall, then say when it falls.
